'''Teksli Yenak''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and member of the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]]. He had a decent scoring but "unremarkable" vital stats as a new hunter in the ancient guild of [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]]. However, being a [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza]], [[Nilesk]] suggested to assign him to an easy target, such as those bounties put by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; [[Opdoa]] proposed a petty criminal, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Terrae Lekes]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].
